name: Lyney
notes: A Pyro bow main DPS. His damage is the Prop Arrow, a Pyro Charged Attack that scales with ATK, so the damage talent is the Normal Attack. Both sources put the Normal Attack first. The table is elemental: the Prop Arrow (172.8% to 185.8% at levels 1 to 2) is on the elemental curve, although his plain Normal Attack hits (38.8% to 41.9%) are on the physical one and are not what he levels for. The 'check' lines are all ATK multipliers. Both sources agree on 4pc Marechaussee Hunter as best, ATK% Sands, Pyro DMG Goblet, a CRIT Circlet, and The First Great Magic, Aqua Simulacra and Thundering Pulse as the top weapons. Vermillion Hereafter is Game8's second set (KQM: best when the Burst is used every rotation) and Shimenawa's Reminiscence and Lavawalker are KQM's. Goals are Game8's: ATK 2,200 or above, CRIT DMG 200% or above, CRIT Rate 50-60% with Marechaussee Hunter (75-80% without), ER 120% or above (about 130% in its build; KQM gives 125-150%).
